Automatic selection of the cold and hot anchor pixels

Source: R/metric-anchors.R
ef_select_anchors.Rd

Selects the cold and hot anchor pixels used by METRIC to calibrate the near-surface temperature difference dT as a function of the surface temperature, following explicit criteria built with ef_anchor_criteria(). The selection uses surface variables only (no net radiation, soil heat flux or weather; stage [A] of dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md section 1.3), is deterministic and returns a complete audit trail: the anchor pixels and their attributes, one calibration point per class, the computed thresholds, the funnel of candidates, the flags and the provenance. The boundary conditions of the anchors are added afterwards by ef_anchor_conditions().

Usage

ef_select_anchors(
  lst,
  ndvi,
  albedo,
  lai = NULL,
  land_cover = NULL,
  qa = NULL,
  elevation = NULL,
  utc_hour = NULL,
  search_area = NULL,
  criteria,
  relax = NULL,
  aggregate,
  cell_size = NULL,
  origin = NULL,
  crs = NULL,
  station = NULL,
  inherited_flags = NULL
)

Arguments

lst

Numeric vector or matrix. Surface temperature [K], > 0. Defines the grid: every other layer must have its length and dim.

ndvi

Numeric vector or matrix. NDVI [-], in [-1, 1].

albedo

Numeric vector or matrix. Broadband surface albedo [-], in [0, 1].

lai

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Leaf area index [m2 m-2], >= 0. Required if a criterion uses it.

land_cover

Numeric vector or matrix of class codes, or NULL. Required if a criterion uses it.

qa

Logical vector or matrix or NULL. TRUE for usable cells (quality control of the surface module); NULL means all cells are usable. No missing values.

elevation

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Elevation [m]; recorded and aggregated for the sensible heat calibration, not used by the selection.

utc_hour

Numeric vector or matrix or NULL. Overpass time of each cell as a decimal UTC hour, in [0, 24). Recorded; anchors of one class with different overpass times are flagged with EF_ANCHOR_OVERPASS_SPREAD.

search_area

Logical vector or matrix (one search domain), an ordered list of them (staged search, e.g. a radius around a station and then the whole scene), or NULL (the whole grid). No missing values.

criteria

An ef_anchor_criteria() object. No default.

relax

NULL (no relaxation; the default, decision D-AP-02) or an ordered list of further ef_anchor_criteria() objects, tried in order for a class that has no candidate with criteria.

aggregate

Character. How the anchor pixels of one class are reduced to the single calibration point of that class (decision P0-9): "mean", "median" or "none" (exactly one pixel per class is required). No default.

cell_size

Numeric or NULL. Side of the (square) cells [m]; recorded (window size in metres) and needed with origin.

origin

Numeric c(x, y) or NULL. Coordinates of the top left corner of the grid in a projected CRS in metres; gives the coordinates of the anchor cell centres.

crs

Character or NULL. Coordinate reference system of origin and station (recorded only).

station

Numeric c(x, y) or NULL. Coordinates of the weather station; gives the distance from each anchor to the station [m]. Needs origin.

inherited_flags

NULL or a list of cell-scope earthflux_flag records evaluated upstream on the grid of lst (indices are positions of the R layers). The codes active at each anchor cell are recorded in pixels$inherited_flags (inheritance rule, dev/specs/flags.md section 3.4).

Value

An object of class c("earthflux_anchors", "list") with elements:

  • pixels: data frame, one row per anchor pixel, ordered by class (cold, hot) and cell: id, type, cell (terra cell number), row, col, x, y [m], lst [K], ndvi, albedo, lai, land_cover, elevation [m], utc_hour [h], qa, window_stat, window_n_valid, window_n, window_complete, lst_rank, ndvi_rank, albedo_rank, lai_rank (empirical cumulative fraction in the grid), distance_to_station [m] and inherited_flags (codes separated by ;).

  • calibration_points: data frame with exactly one row per class ("cold", "hot"): anchor_id, type, n_pixels, aggregate, lst [K], ndvi, albedo, lai, elevation [m], utc_hour [h]; ef_anchor_conditions() adds the energy columns.

  • dispersion: data frame (type, variable, n, mean, median, sd, min, max) of the anchor values of each class.

  • aggregate, criteria (list with criteria, relax and the criteria step used per class), thresholds (computed thresholds), search (domains and where each class was found), funnel (cells left after each filter, per class, search stage and criteria step), relaxation (relaxation steps used), flags (list of earthflux_flag, one per code that holds), method ("criteria"), origin ("automatic"), grid, conditions (NULL until ef_anchor_conditions()), note and provenance (including flags, the flag provenance of dev/specs/flags.md section 6.7, and flags_evaluated, the codes evaluated).

Details

Order of operations (dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md section 5.3): (1) validation; (2) usable cells (qa and the search domain); (3) valid cells (no missing value in a variable used by the criteria); (4) percentile domain and computed thresholds; (5) rules of each class (all must hold); (6) homogeneity; (7) final pick; (8) one calibration point per class and consistency check; (9) flags and audit trail. Each step adds a row to the funnel.

Search domains and relaxation: for each class, the search domains are tried in order and, within each domain, criteria and then the steps of relax; the first combination that leaves at least one anchor pixel is used and recorded. Using a later domain raises EF_ANCHOR_SEARCH_EXPANDED; using a relaxation step raises EF_ANCHOR_CRITERIA_RELAXED, and EF_ANCHOR_HOMOGENEITY_DROPPED when that step has no homogeneity test while criteria had one. Nothing is relaxed without an explicit plan.

Other flags: EF_ANCHOR_SINGLE_PIXEL (a class has one pixel), EF_ANCHOR_TIES (a tie at the limit of a "lowest"/"highest" pick was resolved by cell number), EF_ANCHOR_WINDOW_INCOMPLETE (record scope: rows of pixels whose homogeneity window has missing cells or crosses the grid border) and EF_ANCHOR_OVERPASS_SPREAD.

Errors: no candidate for a class after every domain and step: class earthflux_anchor_no_candidates with fields type ("cold", "hot" or "both"), funnel and thresholds; empty percentile domain: earthflux_anchor_insufficient_domain; hot calibration point not hotter than the cold one: earthflux_anchor_inverted (fields lst_cold, lst_hot). All three also inherit earthflux_anchor_error. Invalid layers or arguments: earthflux_input_error; out-of-domain values: earthflux_domain_error. A small thermal contrast or few candidates are not errors and are not flagged: their thresholds have no reference (class II codes EF_ANCHOR_CONTRAST_LOW, EF_ANCHOR_FEW_CANDIDATES).

The selection uses no random numbers and does not modify the random number generator. Selection on the surface temperature referred to an elevation datum (decision D-AP-07) is not available: lst is used as given.

Verification status: the procedure is a transparent container for user-stated criteria; no criterion is VERIFICADA (dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md sections 3 and 10).

References

Allen, R. G., Tasumi, M., & Trezza, R. (2007). Satellite-based energy balance for mapping evapotranspiration with internalized calibration (METRIC) - Model. Journal of Irrigation and Drainage Engineering, 133(4), 380-394. doi:10.1061/(ASCE)0733-9437(2007)133:4(380)

Allen, R. G., Burnett, B., Kramber, W., Huntington, J., Kjaersgaard, J., Kilic, A., Kelly, C., & Trezza, R. (2013). Automated calibration of the METRIC-Landsat evapotranspiration process. Journal of the American Water Resources Association, 49(3), 563-576. doi:10.1111/jawr.12056

See also

Other anchor pixel functions: ef_anchor_conditions(), ef_anchor_criteria(), ef_anchor_pick(), ef_anchor_rule(), ef_anchors(), ef_homogeneity()

Examples

# A 1 x 12 transect (test case P1 of dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md)
lst <- c(321, 324, 318, 312, 309, 306, 303, 299, 297, 296, 291, 305)
ndvi <- c(0.10, 0.15, 0.20, 0.30, 0.40, 0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.90,
          -0.20, NA)
lai <- c(0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.8, 1.2, 1.8, 2.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 0.0, 1.0)
albedo <- c(0.25, 0.40, 0.22, 0.20, 0.19, 0.19, 0.18, 0.18, 0.19, 0.20,
            0.06, 0.20)
crit <- ef_anchor_criteria(
  cold = list(ef_anchor_rule("ndvi", ">=", 0.75, scale = "percentile"),
              ef_anchor_rule("lai", ">=", 4, scale = "absolute")),
  hot = list(ef_anchor_rule("ndvi", "<=", 0.2, scale = "percentile"),
             ef_anchor_rule("ndvi", ">", 0, scale = "absolute"),
             ef_anchor_rule("albedo", "between", c(0.10, 0.35),
                            scale = "absolute")),
  homogeneity = NULL,
  select = list(cold = ef_anchor_pick("lst", "lowest_fraction", 0.5),
                hot = ef_anchor_pick("lst", "highest_fraction", 0.5)),
  percentile_domain = "land", quantile_type = 7,
  source = "test parameters (dev/specs/anchor-pixels.md 7.1)",
  status = "CANDIDATA"
)
anchors <- ef_select_anchors(lst, ndvi, albedo, lai = lai,
                             criteria = crit, aggregate = "mean")
anchors
#> <earthflux_anchors>
#> Method: criteria (origin: automatic); aggregate: mean
#> Criteria status: CANDIDATA
#>   cold   2 pixel(s), Ts = 296.50 K
#>   hot    1 pixel(s), Ts = 321.00 K
#> Ts hot - Ts cold = 24.50 K
#> Boundary conditions: not set (see ef_anchor_conditions())
#> Flags: EF_ANCHOR_SINGLE_PIXEL (info) 
anchors$calibration_points
#>   anchor_id type n_pixels aggregate   lst ndvi albedo  lai elevation utc_hour
#> 1      cold cold        2      mean 296.5 0.85  0.195 4.75        NA       NA
#> 2       hot  hot        1      mean 321.0 0.10  0.250 0.10        NA       NA
